title: Excellent experience for solo traveler
text: Great experiance from the beginning to the end. Easy to reserve, easy to find the meeting point and real fun experiance. Alfonso was our guide and Gabriella was working on tapas and helping with everything in the back. Both spoke excellent English and were fabulous cooks. It was a hands on experiance. We made sangria and cooked paella from the beginning to the end. There were tapas and Alfonso whipped up a quick almond cake. Everything was delicious. The people participating were friendly and I had a great time. There were three couples in my group, one with a mother, and I was solo. 8 people
author: jolam809

title: Great value and learned a lot
text: Gabriela was an amazing guide and teacher. She was excellent in Spanish and English; very knowledgeable and passionate about cuisine. She took her time to explain methods, history, and made the experience enjoyable and welcoming. Would not hesitate to book another class with her - you’re in for a treat.
